## What's new

- Home focuses on reading. Long-press an app to pin it at the top of the Apps page instead of adding a Home shortcut.
- Apps, Bookshelf, and Settings no longer repeat their tab titles. The bookshelf always shows recently opened books first, and the folder back arrow has the same outline as secondary buttons.
- The bookshelf keeps the local storage permission action out of the way when books are already visible.
- The updater no longer crashes when the reader's unknown-app installation settings cannot open.
